evidence: The LiOH and Li2CO3 films were grown in a viscous flow ALD reactor... The reaction was monitored in situ with a Maxtek, Inc. BSH-150 quartz crystal microbalance (QCM). LiOH ALD films were grown by sequential exposure to LTB (98+%, Strem Chemicals) and H2O (HPLC grade, Honeywell). Li2CO3 ALD is based on a ternary ABC reaction sequence. Li2CO3 ALD films were grown by sequential exposure to LTB, H2O and CO2 (bone dry, Matheson Trigas).
